assumptions: Fix is a router command (suggestion 2 of #71), not reordering the notification wait, because only a command works regardless of message order
usage takes <n> plus --tokens/--tool-uses/--duration-ms (at least one, non-negative safe integers via the exported cleanUsage) and marks the entry usageLate: true
Never overwrite: an identical figure is a no-op, a different one (even a subset) is refused and writes nothing; pending and skip entries are refused

While a step runs the command writes run.jsonl only, with no git; rollback survival comes from rollback/undoRollback writing back the log next read from disk (isolation.mjs:486-487, route.mjs:56), and the next step commit or open-pr leftover commit carries it
Ended runs (meta.outcome present) also rewrite report.md via writeReport

Archive state (outcome done and meta.archive true) prechecks git safety, run branch and a clean change folder, then commits only the folder via an exported routerCommit wrapper with new policy key archive.usageMessage, and restores the old bytes if no commit was made
Cut-off points: before the pull request step in done/halt and before the archive subagent launch; later figures are dropped
The skill rule keeps usage out of any parallel batch with another router call; no lock file
New rule 3 has one bold keyword (**MUST**) and no ladder/model/tier words; skill-loop NEEDLES[2] changes accordingly
New ADR is ADR-019 because ADR-018 is taken by the in-flight no-nested-subagents change; whichever merges second rebases the shared anti-stall sections
Release type fix; the new policy key causes provenance drift for archive on in-flight runs, which is expected
